matrix.label: EMA crossover trend
matrix.rules: Buy when EMA50 crosses above EMA200; stop 4× ATR, trailed at 4× ATR from the best close; exit on the opposite cross.

matrix.label: Donchian breakout
matrix.rules: Buy a close above the 100-bar high; exit on a close beyond the 50-bar opposite channel; stop 3× ATR.

matrix.label: Trend pullback (RSI)
matrix.rules: When price is above EMA200, buy when RSI(14) drops below 30 (mirror for shorts below the EMA); exit when RSI(14) rises above 70 or after 10 bars; stop 3× ATR.

matrix.label: Bollinger mean reversion
matrix.rules: Buy a close below the lower Bollinger band (20, 2σ), sell a close above the upper band; take profit at the middle band; stop 3× ATR; max 30 bars.

matrix.label: Asia range breakout
matrix.rules: Mark the Asia range (8 PM – midnight NY). From 2 AM to 11 AM NY, buy the first close above it; stop at the other side of the range; target 1× the range; close by 4 PM NY.
